description: Per-keyword (search-query) request volume for a marketplace over a period, timezone-aware: total ad requests and the number of distinct days that received requests, grouped by keyword. Used to gauge whether a keyword has enough demand (e.g. >100 requests) to warrant a category. Supply a keyword filter to check specific keywords.

keyword.description: The normalized search query (keyword) users typed, lower-cased and stripped of bracket/quote characters.

requests.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(r.date, 'UTC'), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.request ELSE 0 END), 0)
requests.description: Total ad requests received for this keyword over the period.

days_with_requests.selector: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(r.date, 'UTC'), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(r.date, 'UTC'), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') END)
days_with_requests.description: Number of distinct days (in the marketplace timezone) on which this keyword received at least one request.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.os_product_ads_search_query_request_report` AS r JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketplace_clients` AS mc ON r.marketplace_client_id = mc.marketplace_client_id WHERE mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND DATE(TIMESTAMP(r.date, 'UTC'), '__SP_TIMEZONE__') BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
